🗣️ Last night at the UN, Andy Burnham announced a new National Centre for Information Defence to counter hostile states like Russia.

On that, fair enough. Nobody is defending Kremlin bot farms. 🇷🇺❌

But then came this line:

"Over the last decade we have given too much ground to those who want to run a negative, corrosive narrative about life in Britain, which bears no resemblance to reality. Well, no more."

🤔 Who decides what "bears no resemblance to reality"?

The NHS waiting list stood at 7.33 MILLION cases in July, with around 111,000 people waiting over a year. That's not a foreign narrative — that's the Government's own data.

Counter hostile states, yes. But put it in law that this never gets pointed at British people saying things the Government doesn't like. ⚖️

Full piece 👉 https://lukeparker.co.uk/articles/burnham-un-information-defence-narrative-of-decline-september-2026.html

#FreeSpeech #ReformUK #Burnham
